n50677.source: Flavius Arrianus, Alexandri anabasis, ed. A. G. Roos, Leipzig 1907 (Perseus)

n50681.source: Lucianus, Dialogi deorum, ed. Matthew Donald Macleod, London 1961 (Perseus)
